summary: The Temporalio.Extensions.OpenTelemetry extension does not implement the new ClientOutboundInterceptor methods for standalone activities, preventing client-side span creation when executing activities.
userImpact: Users cannot see client-side tracing spans when executing standalone activities, limiting visibility into activity execution.
rootCause: The ClientOutboundInterceptor methods for standalone activities are not implemented in the OpenTelemetry extension.
proposedFix: Implement the missing ClientOutboundInterceptor methods for standalone activities in Temporalio.Extensions.OpenTelemetry.
keyQuote: Temporalio.Extensions.OpenTelemetry does not currently implement the new ClientOutboundInterceptor methods related to standalone activities.
